t: The facility of the United States Postal Service located at 6483 Lincoln Street in Gagetown, Michigan, shall be known and designated as the “Gagetown Veterans Memorial Post Office”.

fable.w: This section only names a Postal Service facility in Gagetown, Michigan. There is no tempting reading here: it provides for no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government. Congress makes the naming decision directly in the statute.

qwen_block.w: This section simply designates the name of a specific post office facility. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public comment periods, or requirements for outside input mentioned.
